is_anopheles.evidence: Studies wild-caught Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles coluzzii across Africa (page 1251, 'genome-wide scan of CNVs in An. gambiae and An. coluzzii using the whole-genome sequencing from Phase 2 of Ag1000G').

reports_target_markers.evidence: Identifies and genotypes Cyp6aa1 DUP (Cyp6aap_Dup1 to Dup15, covering Cyp6aa1) and Ace-1 DUP (page 1251: 'The largest of these (203,100 bp) was the well-documented duplication in the insecticide target site Ace1'; page 1253: '15 in the Cyp6aa1-Cyp6p2 cluster (Cyp6aap_Dup1-15)').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (page 1254) provides the number and proportion of individuals with a CNV covering Cyp6aa1 across 16 African populations with sample sizes (e.g., Burkina Faso coluzzii: 68/75 [90.7%], Côte d'Ivoire coluzzii: 63/71 [88.7%], Uganda gambiae: 72/112 [64.3%]).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were wild-caught specimens collected across 13 African countries: Angola, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, Equatorial Guinea, Gabon, Ghana, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Kenya, Mayotte, The Gambia, and Uganda (page 1257-1258).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary genomic study discovering, characterizing breakpoints, and genotyping copy number variants (CNVs) across the genomes of the Ag1000G Phase 2 cohort.

sub_country_location.evidence: Mentions Equatorial Guinea (Bioko) in Table 1/2 and Methods (page 1258); site-specific sampling coordinates and village locations are provided in Supplemental Data S10.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Individual sample collection dates within populations span <=3 years, detailed in Supplemental Data S10 (spanning 2000-2012 across the entire multi-country consortium; page 1251).

duplicate_risk.evidence: 'We analyzed data from 1142 individual wild-caught specimens of An. gambiae and An. coluzzii collected and sequenced in Phase 2 of Ag1000G (https://www.malariagen.net/data/ag1000g-phase-2-ar1)' (page 1257).

supplement.evidence: Specific CNV allele counts (e.g., Cyp6aap_Dup1 vs Dup7), sample-level genotypes, and village/site-level metadata are located in 'Supplemental Data S4', 'Supplemental Data S8', and 'Supplemental Data S10' (page 1253, 1258).

assessment.summary: This study analyzes whole-genome sequencing from 1,142 wild-caught An. gambiae and An. coluzzii across 13 African countries from Ag1000G Phase 2 to map copy number variations (CNVs). It identifies extensive copy number variation in major metabolic and target-site insecticide resistance loci, reporting high frequencies of Cyp6aa1 duplications (Cyp6aap_Dup1-15) and documenting Ace-1 duplications.
